provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Darwin's Journey rulebook (ThunderGryph Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Main board on the side for your player count (one side for 1-3, the other for 4)
6 random Special Action tiles faceup on the Diary; box the rest
steps.note: First game - top row: 7 and 8; middle: 1 and 9; bottom: 5 and 12

steps.text: 2 neutral Lens tokens on the two topmost Special Action tiles
3 random Correspondence tiles faceup on the envelope spots
steps.note: First game: tiles 2, 4 and 5, top to bottom

steps.text: Remove 2 Regular Wax Seals per color
Remove 1 Regular Wax Seal per color
Regular Wax Seals shuffled facedown; 1 faceup on each of the 12 Wax Seal spots on the Scrolls
Special (purple) Wax Seals faceup on the silver plate
Silver and golden Objective stacks shuffled facedown; 2 of each faceup below
16 Museum tiles beside the board in the display's order; 1 Coin to the right of each Museum row
Each player's victory point marker on the red book, Evolution marker on the large book
Personal Board, 2 Explorers, 5 Workers, 5 Tents, 6 Lens tokens, 1 Cube, 12 Stamps
4 workers on the bottom-left worker spots (the 5th waits for the leftmost golden Objective)
5 Tents on their spots; Stamps in 3 stacks of 4 on the Stamp spots
Take {c} Coins and {k} Temporary Knowledge token
Crew cards: draft 3 each from hands of 4 passed left, then take the Wax Seals they show
steps.note: First play: in turn order take Crew cards 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-12

steps.text: Starting Objectives: pairs of 1 silver + 1 golden, one pair per player; draft from the rightmost Turn Order marker leftwards
5 rounds; place workers in Turn Order track order, leftmost first
